title: Celebrations
description: Unit V — the days we celebrate together: Children's Day, Mother's Day, Teacher's Day, the New Year and the end of the school year, saying what everybody is entitled to with have and has the right to, telling what happened with the simple past of regular verbs, the three spellings of the -ed ending, the irregular verbs of the unit, was and were, the past time words yesterday, last week and days ago, and the three sounds of the final -ed
sources: Learn and Grow — Year 6 Basic Education, Teacher's Guide (CNP 541608P00), Unit V "Celebrations", pages 42-50 (lessons 1-5 and Progress Check 5, p.50)
